name: facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/loc.build_phase_track: build a phase track signal from world positions by detecting footstep contacts and walking cycle state
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/loc.extract_translations_controls: extract translation and control features including longitudinal speed, height, and walking phase from motion data
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/loc.build_extra_features: build extra features for all subjects and actions in a motion capture dataset
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/loc.phase_to_features: extract amplitude, absolute phase, and angular velocity from a phase signal tensor
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/loc.compute_splines: compute equal-segment-length splines with interpolated tracks for each animation in a motion capture dataset

facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pac.train_pacenetwork: train a PaceNetwork model on motion capture spline dataset sequences with configurable batch size and epochs
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pac.predict_pacenetwork: predict amplitude frequency and direction tracks on a spline using a trained PaceNetwork model
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pac.extract_features_spline: extract curvature and speed input features or amplitude frequency direction output features from a spline
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pac.save_load_pacenetwork_weights: save or load PaceNetwork model weights to and from a file using torch state dict
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pac.compute_angle_operations: compute versor-based angle difference or angle sum between two 2D direction vectors using static methods

facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pos.generate_motion_along_spline: generate a locomotion sequence by following a spline path with an action prefix using PoseNetworkLongTerm
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pos.rotate_batch_augmentation: apply random rotation data augmentation to a batch of pose rotation and position buffers
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pos.compute_positional_loss: compute positional loss with forward kinematics comparing predicted quaternions to expected 3D positions
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pos.prepare_training_batch: prepare and yield augmented training batches of rotations and positions from a motion capture dataset
facebookresearch_quaternet/long_term/pos.review_PoseNetworkLongTerm_class: review the PoseNetworkLongTerm class that extends PoseNetwork for long-term human motion prediction
